blockchain.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
blockchain.excerpt: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
blockchain.excerpt: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

blockchain.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
